newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 current account gap seen 1.4 pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 current account gap seen 1.4 pct/GDP.

text.p: India's current account deficit as a share of gross domestic product (GDP) is projected to fall to below 1.4 percent in 1996/97 from 1.7 percent in 1995/96, the government said on Tuesday.
The government's annual Economic Survey said the current account deficit is forecast to fall to $4.860 billion in 1996/97 (April-March) from $5.434 billion in the previous fiscal year.

The value of exports measured in U.S. dollar terms is expected to grow by between eight and 10 percent in 1996/97, compared to an annual growth rate of 18 to 21 percent in the last three years, it said.
Import growth, on a balance of payments basis, is likely to be about six percent in 1996/97 compared to an average of 29 percent in the last two years.
